input.quote: 15.11 Limitation of Liability. TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW AND NOTWITHSTANDING ANY PROVISION IN THIS AGREEMENT TO THE CONTRARY, NEITHER PARTY WILL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER PARTY FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, SPECIAL, RELIANCE OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES OR LOST OR IMPUTED PROFITS OR ROYALTIES OR COST OF PROCUREMENT OF SUBSTITUTE GOODS OR SERVICES
input.rationale: Section 15.11 is the only limitation-of-liability provision; Section 15.10.2.4 adds a mutual consequential/punitive damages waiver in arbitration but no cap, and Article 12 contains no cap or super-cap. Both parties' direct liability is therefore uncapped and there are no carve-outs, which fails the fallback (mutual cap of 12 months' fees with carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct). Because this Co-Development Agreement has no "Fees" concept, the inserted cap is pegged to expressly identified, determinate twelve-month payment streams and states whose payments count: Development Costs paid or incurred by SFJ (a defined term at 1.1.57, including the SFJ Management Fees) plus PB's Article 6 and Section 14.2 payments to SFJ. That combination keeps the measure meaningful in both directions rather than illusory pre-approval. The retained "for the avoidance of doubt" sentence preserving PB's Article 6 / Section 14.2 payment obligations remains consistent with the new cap. Preferred wording (USD 1,000,000 floor and carve-outs for data protection/security, fraud and IP infringement) is noted as an upgrade if SFJ will accept it.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual aggregate liability cap to Section 15.11 measured by twelve months of identified payments (SFJ's Development Costs and PB's Article 6 / Section 14.2 payments), with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct carved out.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 15.11 excludes consequential damages but leaves each Party's direct liability wholly uncapped, so we added our fallback position: a mutual cap measured by the twelve months of payments actually made under this Agreement (SFJ's Development Costs and PB's Article 6 and Section 14.2 payments), with indemnification, confidentiality breaches, gross negligence and willful misconduct outside the cap.

ops.text: Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement will not exceed the sum of (a) the Development Costs paid or incurred by SFJ and (b) the amounts paid or payable by PB to SFJ under Article 6 and Section 14.2, in each case during the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's indemnification obligations, breach of its confidentiality obligations, gross negligence and willful misconduct.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
